workstream: Wave 3C-3 — Transport completeness from Makati publications
closureRule: Current operating transport assets are mapped only where a current named physical stop/station/terminal can be verified. Historical route rows, headline-only counts, suspended rail stations and future infrastructure are dispositioned without being forced into the default current-operating Civic Map.

familyDispositions.denominatorNote: Not counted automatically against Makati DEPW's published 32-bus-stop denominator because no direct crosswalk has been established.
Useful current public-transport infrastructure, but not treated as one of DEPW's 32 bus stops without documentary equivalence.

notes: The current official count is source-backed but the reviewed authoritative material does not publish the 32 stop names/locations.
The 2022 count was 17 and the reviewed sources do not explain the increase to 32.
An older 36-waiting-shed inventory is lineage evidence only and is not treated as the bus-stop roster.
The source numbering skips 36; no missing route 36 is inferred.
Current corridor continuity is not treated as proof that the 2020 association/operator acronym remains current.
Linear routes are not rendered as fake single-point assets.
Metro Commuter passenger operations have been suspended since March 28, 2024.
Legacy stations are eligible only for a future lifecycle/history layer, not the default current-operating map.
Future NSCR Buendia is not aliased to legacy PNR Dela Rosa.
Future NSCR EDSA and legacy PNR EDSA remain lifecycle-distinct.
No Makati-specific passenger opening date is frozen.
